meta.description: Matches the applicants of a batch against the discovered loan products: the applicants and the products are fetched separately, the candidate pairs are built in the evaluator, the deterministic rules decide, the qualitative stage only sees the residue, and the results are written once.

nodes.name: Acknowledge Request
nodes.notes: The request is acknowledged at once, the matching runs in the background.

parameters.query:
WITH started AS (
  UPDATE ingestion_batches
  SET matching_status = 'running',
      matching_started_at = COALESCE(matching_started_at, NOW())
  WHERE batch_id = '{{ $json.batch_id }}'::uuid
  RETURNING batch_id
)
SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.user_id) AS applicants
FROM (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status,
         u.age, u.city, u.existing_emi, u.eligibility_facts, u.batch_id
  FROM users u
  WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $json.batch_id }}'::uuid
) t

nodes.name: Fetch Batch Applicants
nodes.notes: The applicants of the batch, as one list.  The criteria of the lenders are not repeated for every applicant.

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.product_id) AS products,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp() - '{{ $('Validate Request').first().json.requested_at }}'::timestamptz)) * 1000)::bigint AS fetch_ms
FROM (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.product_key, p.product_name, p.provider,
         p.min_age, p.max_age, p.min_monthly_income, p.max_monthly_income,
         p.min_credit_score, p.max_credit_score, p.min_employment_years,
         p.required_employment_statuses, p.criteria_signature, p.criteria
  FROM loan_products p
  WHERE p.active
) t

nodes.name: Fetch Active Products
nodes.notes: The active policies of the catalogue, sent once per batch.

nodes.name: Evaluate Eligibility Rules
nodes.notes: Stage 2: the candidate pairs are built here and the deterministic rule engine decides every one of them.

nodes.name: Plan Qualitative Checks
nodes.notes: Stage 3a: the ambiguous pairs are reduced to the distinct decisions.

parameters.query:
WITH keys AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text({{ $json.cache_keys_sql }}::jsonb) AS cache_key
)
SELECT c.cache_key, c.criteria_signature, c.user_bucket, c.verdict, c.score,
       c.reasons, c.model, c.prompt_tokens, c.completion_tokens
FROM llm_verdict_cache c
JOIN keys k ON k.cache_key = c.cache_key
 AND NOT c.reasons @> '["The qualitative check could not be completed, a manual review is required"]'::jsonb
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM llm_verdict_cache c JOIN keys k ON k.cache_key = c.cache_key
 AND NOT c.reasons @> '["The qualitative check could not be completed, a manual review is required"]'::jsonb
)

nodes.name: Fetch Cached Verdicts
nodes.notes: The verdicts of previous runs, keyed by criteria profile and applicant bucket.

nodes.name: Build Fast Matches
nodes.notes: The decisions of the whole batch, split into chunks.  Only the confirmed eligibility becomes a match.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.decisions_sql }}::jsonb) AS t(
    batch_id uuid, user_id text, product_id bigint, lane text, status text,
    reasons jsonb, decided_by text, score numeric, llm_assessment jsonb)
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO matching_decisions (batch_id,user_id,product_id,lane,status,reasons)
  SELECT t.batch_id,t.user_id,t.product_id,t.lane,t.status,t.reasons
  FROM incoming t
  ON CONFLICT (batch_id,user_id,product_id) DO UPDATE SET
    lane=EXCLUDED.lane,status=EXCLUDED.status,reasons=EXCLUDED.reasons,updated_at=NOW()
  RETURNING user_id
),
written AS (
  INSERT INTO matches (
    user_id, product_id, status, decided_by, score, reasons, llm_assessment, batch_id, updated_at
  )
  SELECT t.user_id, t.product_id, 'eligible', COALESCE(t.decided_by, 'rules'), t.score,
         t.reasons, t.llm_assessment, t.batch_id, NOW()
  FROM incoming t WHERE t.status = 'eligible'
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    decided_by = EXCLUDED.decided_by,
    score = EXCLUDED.score,
    reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons,
    llm_assessment = EXCLUDED.llm_assessment,
    batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING match_id
),
progress AS (
  UPDATE ingestion_batches
  SET matching_pending_pairs = {{ $json.pending_pairs }},
      fast_completed_at = CASE WHEN {{ $json.is_last }}
        THEN COALESCE(fast_completed_at, NOW()) ELSE fast_completed_at END
  WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Validate Request').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid
  RETURNING batch_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM audit)::int AS decisions_written,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM written)::int AS matches_written,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM progress)::int AS progress_written,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp() - '{{ $json.persist_started_at }}'::timestamptz)) * 1000)::bigint AS persist_ms

nodes.name: Persist Fast Matches
nodes.notes: The one persistence pass of a run that needs no external answer: the audit of every pair and the confirmed matches.

nodes.name: External Checks Needed?
nodes.notes: When nothing has to be asked about, the matching ends with the first persistence step.

nodes.name: Select Missing Checks
nodes.notes: Only the decisions that are not cached yet are sent to the model.

nodes.name: Ask The LLM?
nodes.notes: When every decision is cached the LLM is not called at all.

nodes.name: LLM Qualitative Check
nodes.notes: Stage 3b: the qualitative check. One request per criteria profile and applicant bucket, never one per pair. The requests are spaced out and retried, because the API of the provider rate limits a burst.

parameters.query:
WITH written AS (
  INSERT INTO llm_verdict_cache (
    cache_key, criteria_signature, user_bucket, verdict, score, reasons,
    model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, hits
  )
  SELECT
    t.cache_key, t.criteria_signature, t.user_bucket, t.verdict, t.score, t.reasons,
    t.model, t.prompt_tokens, t.completion_tokens, 1
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.verdicts_sql }}::jsonb) AS t(
    cache_key text, criteria_signature text, user_bucket text, verdict text,
    score numeric, reasons jsonb, model text, prompt_tokens int, completion_tokens int
  )
  ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET
    verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict,
    score = EXCLUDED.score,
    reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons,
    model = EXCLUDED.model,
    prompt_tokens = EXCLUDED.prompt_tokens,
    completion_tokens = EXCLUDED.completion_tokens,
    hits = llm_verdict_cache.hits + 1
  RETURNING cache_key
)
SELECT count(*)::int AS verdicts_cached FROM written

nodes.name: Apply External Verdicts
nodes.notes: Stage 4: only the pairs whose answer arrived are updated.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.decisions_sql }}::jsonb) AS t(
    batch_id uuid, user_id text, product_id bigint, lane text, status text,
    reasons jsonb, decided_by text, score numeric, llm_assessment jsonb)
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO matching_decisions (batch_id,user_id,product_id,lane,status,reasons)
  SELECT t.batch_id,t.user_id,t.product_id,t.lane,t.status,t.reasons
  FROM incoming t
  ON CONFLICT (batch_id,user_id,product_id) DO UPDATE SET
    lane=EXCLUDED.lane,status=EXCLUDED.status,reasons=EXCLUDED.reasons,updated_at=NOW()
  RETURNING user_id
),
written AS (
  INSERT INTO matches (
    user_id, product_id, status, decided_by, score, reasons, llm_assessment, batch_id, updated_at
  )
  SELECT t.user_id, t.product_id, 'eligible', COALESCE(t.decided_by, 'rules'), t.score,
         t.reasons, t.llm_assessment, t.batch_id, NOW()
  FROM incoming t WHERE t.status = 'eligible'
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    decided_by = EXCLUDED.decided_by,
    score = EXCLUDED.score,
    reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons,
    llm_assessment = EXCLUDED.llm_assessment,
    batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING match_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM audit)::int AS decisions_written,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM written)::int AS matches_written,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp() - '{{ $json.persist_started_at }}'::timestamptz)) * 1000)::bigint AS persist_ms

nodes.name: Persist External Updates
nodes.notes: The pairs whose answer arrived are written again; the rest of the batch is not touched.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO matching_runs (
  run_id, batch_id, started_at, completed_at, applicants, products,
  candidate_pairs, evaluated_pairs, decisions_written, matches_written,
  external_updates, payload_bytes, fetch_ms, rules_ms, persist_ms, external_ms,
  llm_requests, llm_verdicts, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens
)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(), t.batch_id, COALESCE(t.started_at::timestamptz, NOW()), NOW(),
  t.applicants, t.products, t.candidate_pairs, t.evaluated_pairs, t.decisions_written,
  t.matches_written, t.external_updates, t.payload_bytes, t.fetch_ms, t.rules_ms,
  t.persist_ms, t.external_ms, t.llm_requests, t.llm_verdicts, t.prompt_tokens,
  t.completion_tokens
FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.run_sql }}::jsonb) AS t(
  batch_id uuid, started_at text, applicants int, products int, candidate_pairs int,
  evaluated_pairs int, decisions_written int, matches_written int, external_updates int,
  payload_bytes bigint, fetch_ms bigint, rules_ms bigint, persist_ms bigint, external_ms bigint,
  llm_requests int, llm_verdicts int, prompt_tokens int, completion_tokens int
)
RETURNING run_id

nodes.name: Record Run Metrics
nodes.notes: How long the stages took, how many bytes travelled through the workflow and how many rows were written.

parameters.query:
WITH removed AS (
  DELETE FROM matches m WHERE m.batch_id = '{{ $('Validate Request').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matching_decisions d
    WHERE d.batch_id=m.batch_id AND d.user_id=m.user_id AND d.product_id=m.product_id
      AND d.status = 'eligible')
  RETURNING match_id
)
UPDATE ingestion_batches SET matching_status = 'completed', matching_completed_at = NOW(), matching_pending_pairs = 0 WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Validate Request').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid RETURNING batch_id

nodes.name: Trigger Notification Workflow
nodes.notes: The notification workflow answers at once, so the mail server never holds the matching back.

nodes.name: Decider Qualitative Check
nodes.notes: Resolve each request independently: preserve Decider successes, retry unanswered questions, use LLM fallback only for failures.

nodes.name: Use LLM Fallback?
nodes.notes: When every decision is cached the LLM is not called at all.
